evidence_class: Static frozen-source review only. QA ran no compile, test, solver, physical assembly, or numerical calculation.

findings.title: R01 encodes the historical rank refusal as the required result, so it cannot pass after the intended body consumes the hold.
findings.evidence: The test calls solve_subproblem(...).expect_err, then requires RankDeficient and a refusal capture. A correct BVLS05 body is intended to pass the initial held 21-by-19 face; it will return Ok and fail before the capture/21-row assertions. This is not an expected-red assertion that can transition to the planned post-body behavior.
findings.required_fix: Capture and assert the reached first-face operands independently of later Ok/Err, then make the pre-body rank refusal and the post-body held-face result explicit separate phases or controls. Do not require RankDeficient in the green body-control path.

findings.title: R05/R06 do not implement plan05's required refinement-join and reconstruction assertions.
findings.evidence: They assert only the final scaled step/lambda/residual/h, a 21-entry KKT length, one factorization, and a subset of BVLS05 work. They do not assert p0/p1/p2 held +0 bits, the 19 free_ids/factor/order cardinality at every join, held base-coordinate bit reconstruction through the body, or the specified full KKT held h/cbar/tau/class contribution. Those omissions can allow an incorrectly scattered/reduced face to satisfy the final-vector checks.
findings.required_fix: Expose or record the real returned refinement/face observations and assert all plan05 R05/R06 joins, including 19-entry ordering, p0/p1/p2 held values, full 21-coordinate KKT fields, and reconstructed held base bits.

findings.title: Dedicated work accounting is only partially asserted and does not yet demonstrate plan05's default-versus-inspected additive contract.
findings.evidence: The scaffold defines and absorb-adds dedicated test-only counters, which is appropriate. The controls mainly check role attempts and column attempts, one held-copy completion, or a less-than bound for mask joins. They omit exact completed counterparts, held-copy attempts, exact mask deltas, and post-solve additive deltas. R07 checks a helper with empty roles but does not compare its body-path numerical/result observation to retained BVLS03/BVLS04 vectors.
findings.required_fix: Assert exact attempted/completed deltas for all four dedicated counter families in inspected and default-empty cases, plus their additive composition with returned work; prove R07's no-provenance body path preserves the retained routing/result observations and has zero BVLS05 deltas.

findings.location: g4-rank-controls compile inventory01 (reported by executor; source cut above unchanged)
findings.title: The supplied controls source has not reached a runnable expected-red gate.
findings.evidence: The executor reports compile inventory01 failed with 20 mechanical errors. This is not an expected-red result and supplies no test readiness evidence.
findings.required_fix: Correct the mechanical compile failures, preserve the failed receipt, and rerun the exact controls inventory/selection on an exact new source manifest after the assertion-scope fixes above.

verified_positive_scope.private_confinement: Added BVLS05 provenance, certificate, scatter helper, counters, and test fixtures are cfg(test)/crate-private; no default/public dispatch is introduced.
verified_positive_scope.body_isolation: The certificate is explicitly test-only and static call inspection finds no numerical-body consumption. This scaffold therefore does not itself implement or authorize the BVLS05 numerical method.
verified_positive_scope.selector_inventory: All eight plan05 pre-body selector names are present, but their assertion coverage and compilation are insufficient for execution.

disposition: BLOCKED: do not run the expected-red controls gate on this source. Body/G4 remain gated; this review neither executes nor releases a numerical change.
